title: fix(react): evaluate a ${…} hole inside an inline locale map like a plain string (objectui#12936)
body:
Fixes #12936

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/react`'s `SchemaRenderer` now honours a shape it used to hand over raw: each member of an inline locale map in a node's config bag is evaluated like a plain string on the same key. No export is added or removed and no type changes; the set of authored values the renderer evaluates widens by that one shape.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (claim comment 6246422606), triage route 1 (comment 6246364337). Session `https://claude.ai/code/session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`.

## What changed

- **`packages/react/src/utils/localeMap.ts` (new).** `isInlineLocaleMap` asks `@objectstack/spec/ui`'s own `InlineLocaleMapSchema` (every key a locale tag or `default`, never `key` / `defaultValue`; every value a string), behind a fast reject on a non-string member that can only refuse what the schema refuses. `mapLocaleMapMembers` maps each member through a visitor, spells the result as a string, and copies on write, so a map without a hole comes back as the very object that went in.
- **`SchemaRenderer.tsx`, `evaluateConfigValueWith`** (the one per-value rule): inside the data-object branch, an inline locale map has each member evaluated by the same evaluator, so against the same scope as a plain string on that key. Every other data object keeps the objectui#10288 hand-over, with no walk. This one rule serves the memo's node-level `params`, `properties` and `props` loops and `evaluateConfigBagInScope` (`useConfigBagEvaluator`), so every carrier moves together. The docblocks of `isDataObjectValue` and `evaluateConfigValueWith`, and the two memo comments that describe the shallow radius, now name the one-level exception.
- **`utils/unevaluatedExpression.ts`.** `scanBag` walks a locale map's members through the same recogniser and walker, so a member whose expression throws (the evaluator keeps its source text) is reported by its locale, for example `properties.title.en`, as a plain string with the same hole is. Its "Depth" docblock records the second shape. The message text is unchanged.
- **`content/docs/guide/expressions.md`**: a short "Localized Copy" subsection (AGENTS.md #2).
- **`.changeset/12936-locale-map-holes.md`**: `@object-ui/react` minor.

A member's result is always a string: a member that is one whole hole, `'${data.count}'`, resolves to the number as a plain string does, and a number member would be skipped by every `pickLocalized` limb (each reads string entries only), so the viewer would get another locale's line. `String(result ?? '')` is the spelling the evaluator already gives an interpolated part of a plain string.

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **Site and call paths: confirmed.** `isDataObjectValue` hands every non-envelope object on a non-predicate key over as authored. Its only reader is `evaluateConfigValueWith`, and that is the rule behind node-level `params`, the `properties` loop, the `props` loop (through the memo's `evaluateConfigValue`) and `evaluateConfigBagInScope`. **The diagnostic had to learn the shape too.** Its own header says "Depth: exactly the evaluator's own radius, and not one level more". Without the scan change, a member whose hole throws stays raw and says nothing, while the same plain string is reported. Ablation 2 below shows this.
2. **Recogniser: the spec's, reused.** `@object-ui/i18n` has no `isInlineLocaleMap` (`pickLocalized` accepts any object), and `plugin-dashboard`'s module-private `isLocaleMap` is "any non-array object", which is too wide. The installed `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.3` declares `InlineLocaleMapSchema` at runtime as a `z.record` of a locale-tag key regex to `z.string()`. Verdicts measured through it: the card's map true; `{ source, campaign }` false; a 30-key mixed data object false; an expression envelope false; a `Date` false; `{ id, url }` **true** (see Acceptance notes). Cost measured on this box: about 2 microseconds for a map; the member pre-check turns away most data objects before the schema runs.
3. **Scope: confirmed.** The memo builds `predicateScope` as the ambient scope plus `data: apiData` once the API binding's status is `ready`, and `configEvaluationScope` adds `current_user`, `record` and `page`. The members go through that same evaluator, pinned once per root: `record`, `page`, `current_user`, and `data` under an API binding.
4. **Predicate-chain keys and envelopes keep their rules.** The locale branch sits inside `isDataObjectValue`, which already excludes `PREDICATE_CHAIN_KEYS` and spec envelopes. An envelope can never be a locale map, because `dialect` and `source` fail the key regex. No locale map on a predicate key was found.
5. **Consumers: no change needed.** Measured end to end: `hero` (reads `schema.properties`, then `pickLocalized`) and `element:text` (reads through `readProps`, then `pickLocalized`) both draw the evaluated member. No consumer was found re-reading the raw node.

## Tests (all on head `3d521e22`)

- New `packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.localeMapHoles-12936.test.tsx`: `Tests 15 passed (15)`. It pins member/plain-string parity per root (record, page, current_user, data under an API binding), the `props` alias, `evaluateConfigBagInScope`, the whole-hole string spelling, four data-object controls (non-string member, nested object member, non-locale key, the retired `key` / `defaultValue` form) and the no-hole identity control. It also has three diagnostic cases: a throwing member reported by its locale, an evaluated member not reported, and the scan walking a locale map and nothing else.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/__tests__/localeMapHole-12936.test.tsx`: `Tests 6 passed (6)`. It covers the card's zh / en `hero` `title` with a `data.*` hole under the real API binding, the zh / en no-hole control, and `element:text` in zh-CN / en.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/react/`: `Test Files 117 passed (117)`, `Tests 1464 passed (1464)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Consumer sweep: `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/`, `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/__tests__/`, five locale/aria suites in `packages/components/src/__tests__/`, `packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/__tests__/` and `DeclaredActionsBar.test.tsx`: `Test Files 65 passed (65)`, `Tests 984 passed (984)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, after `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/components^..." run build`. A `--listFiles` count shows both new files are read.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check: narrowed to the new test file (a temporary project extending `tsconfig.test.json`, deleted afterwards) because the full project needs about 30 package builds. Exit 0, and `--listFiles` shows it read the test and `productBlocks.tsx`. The full project is left to CI's Type Check.

## Ablations (committed first; mutation and restore through `ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, restore proven by blob equals HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

1. **Evaluation branch** (`mapLocaleMapMembers(value, …)` replaced by `value` in `evaluateConfigValueWith`). Predicted: every parity pin red, the hero and `element:text` reads red, the diagnostic's "evaluated member is not reported" control red (direction: more diagnostics, because the members stay raw), and every data-object control green. Observed `Tests 12 failed | 9 passed (21)`, exactly those 12. Restored to blob `1d4dc859ba4c`, equal to HEAD.
2. **Diagnostic branch** (the `isInlineLocaleMap` test in `scanBag` made false). Predicted and observed: `Tests 2 failed | 13 passed (15)`, namely the throwing-member report and the scan pin. Restored to blob `681dee2e782c`, equal to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface beyond the claim.** The claim names `SchemaRenderer.tsx`, the tests and one changeset. This diff also adds `utils/localeMap.ts`, the shared recogniser and walker, following `utils/paramsBag.ts`. It also edits `utils/unevaluatedExpression.ts` for diagnostic parity (assumption 1) and `content/docs/guide/expressions.md` (AGENTS.md #2). Nothing in the claim's not-in-scope list is touched: `pickLocalized`, block prop reads, the save path and spec keys are all unchanged. The seat may want to amend the claim's file surface.
- **Boundary that follows from reusing the contract.** An object whose keys all parse as locale tags (any two or three letters do, so `{ id, url }` qualifies) and whose values are all strings is an inline locale map to `InlineLocaleMapSchema`, so it is one here too, and a `${…}` in its members is now evaluated. A source grep found no authored data object of that shape carrying a hole; the matches were JS template literals. Recorded, not filed. Carrier: none.
- **Node-level keys stay string-only.** The node-level `content` leg and the spec's expression-bindable node keys (`statistic` / `card` / `button`) still evaluate strings only, so a locale map written at node level stays raw. The diagnostic now names such a member, since it scans locale maps on every channel as it scans strings, and its message points the author to `properties.*`, which evaluates it. No producer was measured writing that shape. Recorded, not filed. Carrier: none.
- **No walk.** A locale map nested inside another data object (for example `aria.ariaLabel`) stays raw, by the ruling.
- **`needs:contract-review`.** Clause-② is yes; this run's definition does not ask the dev to hang the marker, so no label was written. That is the seat's call before ready.
